gloss_en: potential (koach) — the latent, not-yet-actualized state of a thing, paired with and opposed to po'al (the actual/actualized), as in bringing something 'from potential to actual'; the initial thought before the deed

outliers.actual_gloss_en: strength, force — the power/vigor exerted (here, praying with strength, 'He gives you strength to make wealth')
outliers.reason: Same spelling and vocalization, but here כח means exerted strength/power (praying with koach to rectify Malkhut), not the philosophical 'potential' opposed to 'actual' of lm1:66; distinct sense.
